import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not data:
        return
    num = int(data)
    original = num
    rev = 0
    for _ in range(5):
        rev = rev * 10 + num % 10
        num //= 10
    print(rev)
    print(original + rev)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
